requirements: R1: Patch the synchronization logic to correctly read GitHub PR closed events that lack a merge action, ensuring the internal task status correctly updates instead of falsely remaining 'done'.

slices.title: Patch GitHub PR status synchronization logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization fix for this epic, I want to accurately parse the 'closed without merge' GitHub event and map it to the internal task state, so that the status discrepancy is resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an open PR in the internal system,
When the PR is closed on GitHub without being merged,
Then the internal task status is updated using an atomically-guarded database update,
And tests verify this behavior without invoking hardcoded compliance stubs.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce task-PR status discrepancy incidents from >100 observed errors to 0 per 100 synchronization events.
